// AUTO-GENERATED baseline MHA kernel (S=64, D=64, H=4, H_kv=4, causal=0, fp8:e4m3).
void solution(void) {
  // Define missing constants
  #define HEADS_PER_KV 1
  #define ATT_HKV 4
  #define ATT_S 64
  #define ATT_D 64
  #define DIM 16
  #define BANK_NUM 4
  #define BANK_ROWS 2048
  #define ACC_ROWS 256
  #define MAX_BLOCK_LEN 4
  #define MAX_BLOCK_LEN_ACC 1
  #define SPAD_DEST 0
  #define QSS_BYTES (ATT_S * sizeof(uint8_t))
  #define VSS_BYTES (ATT_S * sizeof(uint8_t))
  #define S_OUT_COLS ATT_S
  #define D_OUT_COLS ATT_D
  #define GROUPS_S (ATT_S / 32)
  #define MX_FRAC 16
  #define MX_P_TARGET_LOG2 8
  
  // Head-group buffered workspaces to allow multi-head reuse of KT and V within a KV group
  static uint64_t S1_hw_group[HEADS_PER_KV][ATT_S][ATT_S / 4];
  static uint8_t P_q_group[HEADS_PER_KV][ATT_S][ATT_S];
  static uint8_t P_scales_group[HEADS_PER_KV][GROUPS_S][ATT_S];

  // External data pointers (simulating the original context)
  elem_t *QTs[ATT_HKV];
  uint8_t *QTss[ATT_HKV];
  elem_t *KTs[ATT_HKV];
  uint8_t *KTss[ATT_HKV];
  elem_t *Vs[ATT_HKV];
  uint8_t *Vss[ATT_HKV];
  elem_t *Qs[4];
  uint8_t *Qss[4];
  uint8_t *scale_factors;
  elem_t *O_hw[4];

  for (int kv = 0; kv < ATT_HKV; kv++) {
    
    // ---- 1) S1 = Q @ K^T on Gemmini (with KT scratchpad reuse) ----
    {
      int tiles_I = ATT_S / DIM;
      int tiles_J = ATT_S / DIM;
      int tiles_K = ATT_D / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;

      const elem_t *KT_in = KTs[kv];
      const uint8_t *KT_sc = KTss[kv];

      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      
      // Load KT (weight B) scale factors once for this group
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)KT_sc, QSS_BYTES, 1);

      // Load KT (weight B) tiles once into scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j += 2) {
          int bb = (tiles_J - j < 2) ? (tiles_J - j) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)KT_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_S + j * DIM),
                                b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Process all Query heads mapping to this KV head
      for (int head_idx = 0; head_idx < HEADS_PER_KV; head_idx++) {
        int h = kv * HEADS_PER_KV + head_idx;
        const elem_t *Q_in = Qs[h];
        const uint8_t *Q_sc = Qss[h];

        // Load Q scale factors (activation A)
        gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)Q_sc, QSS_BYTES, 0);

        // Load Q (activation A) tiles into scratchpad
        gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t));
        for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
          for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k += 2) {
            int bb = (tiles_K - k < 2) ? (tiles_K - k) : 2;
            gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)Q_in) + i * DIM * ATT_D + k * DIM),
                                  a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
          }
        }

        // Run hardware WS compute loop using the pre-loaded KT tiles from the scratchpad (skips=0x38)
        gemmini_config_st(S_OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
        gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
        gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 0, a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                             SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&S1_hw_group[head_idx][0][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, ATT_S * ATT_S);
        gemmini_fence();
      }
    }

    // ---- 2) FLOAT-FREE integer softmax + fp8 requant ----
    for (int head_idx = 0; head_idx < HEADS_PER_KV; head_idx++) {
      for (int i = 0; i < ATT_S; i++) {
        int64_t q[ATT_S];
        int64_t mq = -((int64_t)1 << 62);
        
        // SWAR BF16 Unpacking
        for (int j = 0; j < ATT_S; j += 4) {
          uint64_t w = S1_hw_group[head_idx][i][j / 4];
          uint16_t w0 = (uint16_t)(w & 0xFFFF);
          uint16_t w1 = (uint16_t)((w >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
          uint16_t w2 = (uint16_t)((w >> 32) & 0xFFFF);
          uint16_t w3 = (uint16_t)((w >> 48) & 0xFFFF);

#if 0 // ATT_CAUSAL disabled as per original code
          if (j > i) { q[j] = -((int64_t)1 << 62); } 
          else { int64_t qq = mx_ibf16_to_q(w0); q[j] = qq; if (qq > mq) mq = qq; }

          if (j + 1 > i) { q[j + 1] = -((int64_t)1 << 62); } 
          else { int64_t qq = mx_ibf16_to_q(w1); q[j + 1] = qq; if (qq > mq) mq = qq; }

          if (j + 2 > i) { q[j + 2] = -((int64_t)1 << 62); } 
          else { int64_t qq = mx_ibf16_to_q(w2); q[j + 2] = qq; if (qq > mq) mq = qq; }

          if (j + 3 > i) { q[j + 3] = -((int64_t)1 << 62); } 
          else { int64_t qq = mx_ibf16_to_q(w3); q[j + 3] = qq; if (qq > mq) mq = qq; }
#else
          int64_t qq0 = mx_ibf16_to_q(w0); q[j] = qq0; if (qq0 > mq) mq = qq0;
          int64_t qq1 = mx_ibf16_to_q(w1); q[j + 1] = qq1; if (qq1 > mq) mq = qq1;
          int64_t qq2 = mx_ibf16_to_q(w2); q[j + 2] = qq2; if (qq2 > mq) mq = qq2;
          int64_t qq3 = mx_ibf16_to_q(w3); q[j + 3] = qq3; if (qq3 > mq) mq = qq3;
#endif
        }

        int64_t p[ATT_S];
        int64_t sm = 0;
        int64_t gmax_arr[GROUPS_S];
        for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
          int64_t gmax = 0;
          for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++) {
            int64_t pv = mx_iexp(q[j] - mq);
            p[j] = pv;
            sm += pv;
            if (pv > gmax) gmax = pv;
          }
          gmax_arr[g] = gmax;
        }
        
        int ls = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)sm);
        uint64_t inv_sm = (((uint64_t)1 << (ls + MX_FRAC)) + ((uint64_t)sm >> 1)) / (uint64_t)sm;

        for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
          int64_t gmax = gmax_arr[g];
          if (gmax == 0) { 
            P_scales_group[head_idx][g][i] = 0; 
            for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j += 8) {
              *((uint64_t*)&P_q_group[head_idx][i][j]) = 0;
            }
            continue; 
          }
          
          int e = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)gmax) - ls - MX_P_TARGET_LOG2;
          P_scales_group[head_idx][g][i] = (uint8_t)(e + 127);
          
          // SWAR 8-way Parallel Packing of FP8 Elements 
          for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j += 8) {
            uint64_t packed_val = 0;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 0], inv_sm, ls, e));
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 1], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 8;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 2], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 16;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 3], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 24;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 4], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 32;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 5], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 40;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 6], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 48;
            packed_val |= ((uint64_t)mx_ienc_fp8(p[j + 7], inv_sm, ls, e)) << 56;
            *((uint64_t*)&P_q_group[head_idx][i][j]) = packed_val;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- 3) O = P @ V on Gemmini (with V scratchpad reuse) ----
    {
      int tiles_I = ATT_S / DIM;
      int tiles_J = ATT_D / DIM;
      int tiles_K = ATT_S / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;

      const elem_t *V_in = Vs[kv];
      const uint8_t *V_sc = Vss[kv];

      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      
      // Load V scale factors (weight B) once for this group
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)V_sc, VSS_BYTES, 1);

      // Load V (weight B) tiles once into scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j += 2) {
          int bb = (tiles_J - j < 2) ? (tiles_J - j) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)V_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_D + j * DIM),
                                b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Process all Query heads mapping to this KV head
      for (int head_idx = 0; head_idx < HEADS_PER_KV; head_idx++) {
        int h = kv * HEADS_PER_KV + head_idx;

        // Load Softmax output scale factors (activation A)
        gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&P_scales_group[head_idx][0][0], sizeof(P_scales_group[head_idx]), 0);

        // Load Softmax output P_q (activation A) tiles into scratchpad
        gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t));
        for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
          for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k += 2) {
            int bb = (tiles_K - k < 2) ? (tiles_K - k) : 2;
            gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)P_q_group[head_idx]) + i * DIM * ATT_S + k * DIM),
                                  a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM);
          }
        }

        // Run hardware WS compute loop using the pre-loaded V tiles from the scratchpad (skips=0x38)
        gemmini_config_st(D_OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
        gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
        gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 0, a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                             SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&O_hw[h][0][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, ATT_S * ATT_D);
        gemmini_fence();
      }
    }
  }
}
